text: This week, Pamela Julie Case's (PJC1252) activity triggered two detection rules. The main evidence for this comes from two triggered rules: [R2] Elevated number of files copied to removable media and [R4] Browsing to job-search or leak-publication sites atypical for the role. Specifically, [F001] shows 15 files copied to removable media, which is well above her usual range. Additionally, [F002] indicates 12 visits to job-search sites, which is not only above her typical activity but also above the range seen among her peers in the same role.
